verdict.rationale: Undermind is driven by natural-language research goals. It asks follow-up questions, lets users iterate on reports and brainstorm with an AI, and exposes workspace actions (notes, folders, stars) to chat agents via MCP, where users invoke it with `@Undermind`. Community users confirm that natural-language prompts work better than keyword fiddling. Missing for 10: documentation that every product operation (e.g., alert/settings configuration, workspace management in the native UI) can be done by natural-language command, and independent hands-on reports of operating it conversationally through MCP clients.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Runs a deep literature review from an open-ended research goal and produces a ranked list of papers with a written synthesis.
Undermind asks follow-up questions to understand exactly what you need.
Iterate on reports, dive into full texts, extract details, and refine your understanding.
Once connected, begin a new chat and type `@Undermind`.
Creates and edits Markdown notes, syntheses, and reports in the workspace.
